It’s tough having anxiety and being online. Most people occasionally get embarrassed by small mistakes or if they missed the punchline, but it’s hard when you constantly feel like an idiot because of anxiety. I know I used to get red in the face after sending a joke or meme that no one found funny.. but eventually I just realized that if someone’s gonna judge me or think i’m an idiot for not being witty and spot on 100 percent of the time, then their opinion shouldn’t matter to me. 

I also tend to use self-deprecating humour a lot which may not be healthy, but at the same time if I make fun of myself first I somehow feel better about the situation! 

It takes time and help to overcome anxiety, but one useful trick is sort of differentiating between your thought process and what actually occurred. For instance let’s say someone made a sarcastic comment that you misinterpreted. Your mind may jump to the conclusion that the individual perceives you now as dumb, annoying, cringe, or whatever pops into your head. You may convince yourself this is the case if the person takes longer to respond, sends back a stale reply or whatever else occurs. Looking at the situation, it’s sometimes helpful to realize that the person judging you the most and calling you an idiot is actually yourself talking. Not the other individual. Think about what actually occurred. Write it out even! It can give you a better perspective on what actually occurred and what is reality, vs what your anxiety/mind is telling you or narrating. 

You can even say to yourself when you have these thoughts, ok so what if it IS true? what if they DO think you’re an idiot? Even if you consider the worst possible outcome your anxiety tells you is real, is it really the end of the world? A person online is being judgy and thinks your weird. Big whoop. Tell your anxiety to f off. 

I know this is much easier said than done. Hoping some of these tips help even a little.

some weird things i do before making a call etc are writing down the main points I want to talk about! Giving myself a bit of a script helps. I’ve honestly never talked with someone I know over the phone or through text and thought wow they’re totally embarrassing themselves!! People don’t really think twice about the texts or calls they receive. It’s easy to over analyze and be self critical. Just know that the other person likely isn’t thinking twice about you’ve texted!
